# Ars Belli focus picks: scripted GUIs for the Focus Picks panel. GENERATED by
# .tools/scripts/focus_picks/generate_focus_picks.js - edit focus_data.js and re-run.
# Change points: abm_focus_changes_used counts switches (missing = 0); at most 3.

abm_focus_pick_court = {
	scope = country
	is_shown = { NOT = { OR = { has_variable = abm_focus_court has_variable = abm_focus_trade has_variable = abm_focus_influence } } }
	is_valid = {
		custom_tooltip = {
			text = abm_focus_panel.age_2_renaissance.reached_tt
			OR = { current_age = age_2_renaissance current_age = age_3_discovery current_age = age_4_reformation current_age = age_5_absolutism current_age = age_6_revolutions }
		}
	}
	effect = { set_variable = abm_focus_court }
}

abm_focus_switch_court = {
	scope = country
	is_shown = {
		NOT = { has_variable = abm_focus_court }
		OR = { has_variable = abm_focus_trade has_variable = abm_focus_influence }
	}
	is_valid = {
		custom_tooltip = {
			text = ABM_FOCUS_CHANGES_NONE_TT
			OR = {
				NOT = { has_variable = abm_focus_changes_used }
				var:abm_focus_changes_used < 3
			}
		}
	}
	effect = {
		if = { limit = { has_variable = abm_focus_trade } remove_variable = abm_focus_trade }
		if = { limit = { has_variable = abm_focus_influence } remove_variable = abm_focus_influence }
		set_variable = abm_focus_court
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = abm_focus_changes_used }
			change_variable = { name = abm_focus_changes_used add = 1 }
		}
		else = { set_variable = { name = abm_focus_changes_used value = 1 } }
	}
}

abm_focus_pending = {
	scope = country
	is_shown = {
		OR = {
			AND = {
				current_age = age_2_renaissance
				OR = {
					NOT = { OR = { has_variable = abm_focus_court has_variable = abm_focus_trade has_variable = abm_focus_influence } }
					NOT = { OR = { has_variable = abm_focus_levy has_variable = abm_focus_mercenary has_variable = abm_focus_maritime } }
				}
			}
			AND = {
				current_age = age_3_discovery
				OR = {
					NOT = { OR = { has_variable = abm_focus_infrastructure has_variable = abm_focus_exploration has_variable = abm_focus_diplomatic } }
					NOT = { OR = { has_variable = abm_focus_quality has_variable = abm_focus_quantity has_variable = abm_focus_naval } }
				}
			}
			AND = {
				current_age = age_4_reformation
				OR = {
					NOT = { OR = { has_variable = abm_focus_religion has_variable = abm_focus_expansion has_variable = abm_focus_humanism } }
					NOT = { OR = { has_variable = abm_focus_offense has_variable = abm_focus_defense has_variable = abm_focus_littoral_fleet } }
				}
			}
			AND = {
				current_age = age_5_absolutism
				OR = {
					NOT = { OR = { has_variable = abm_focus_administration has_variable = abm_focus_commerce has_variable = abm_focus_espionage } }
					NOT = { OR = { has_variable = abm_focus_maneuver has_variable = abm_focus_logistics has_variable = abm_focus_highseas_fleet } }
				}
			}
			AND = {
				current_age = age_6_revolutions
				OR = {
					NOT = { OR = { has_variable = abm_focus_industry has_variable = abm_focus_empire has_variable = abm_focus_innovation } }
					NOT = { OR = { has_variable = abm_focus_voluntary_service has_variable = abm_focus_conscription has_variable = abm_focus_insurrection } }
				}
			}
		}
	}
}
